svg.title: E-commerce on Google Cloud: reference architecture
svg.text: E-commerce on Google Cloud: a reference architecture for a store that has to stay up on its busiest day
One anycast IP at the edge, two active regions behind it, one multi-region source of truth, and everything slow or optional moved off the checkout path.
1 Global edge: one anycast IP for the whole world
2 Compute: two active regions, either one can carry the whole load
storefront BFF, catalog, cart, checkout, orders, inventory
storefront BFF, catalog, cart, checkout, orders, inventory
3 Data: one source of truth that survives a region
4 Events and intelligence: everything that can happen after the order is placed
5 Landing zone: the guardrails under every project
fixed egress IPs for the PSP
paged on SLO burn, not CPU
Checkout only depends on layers 1, 2, 3 and the PSP. Everything in layer 4 can be slow or down for an hour and nobody loses an order.
Example regions; Spanner nam3 puts read-write replicas in us-east4 and us-east1 with a witness in us-central1. Product names as of November 2026.
